prospective_amendment.timing: after the Real-1h gate result but before any matched synthetic generation or synthetic learner score
prospective_amendment.authorization_basis: user-directed cost amendment selecting locally run LTX-2.3 instead of hosted MiniMax H3 after the hosted one-hour price was judged unsuitable for a lean prototype
prospective_amendment.supersedes: the hosted MiniMax H3 amendment recorded at 821fddc22ad9fbf2e94b8c6c5cf1111ed09d042b; Git history retains its provenance
prospective_amendment.outcome_independence: the Real-1h result requires the already frozen Real-3h extension; no generator outcome from the matched corpus and no synthetic learner score was observed
prospective_amendment.unchanged: the Real-1h result and Real-3h rule; equal credited duration; fixed learner seed initialization schedule steps checkpoint evaluation assets language adapter gates and directional interpretation rule

learner.objective_step_basis: 30 times 19 upstream-sized batches from the frozen Real-1h manifest; all matched trained arms stop after exactly 570 scheduler steps

calibration_C.semantic_boundary: public semantic categories and frequency bands only; never exact C vocabulary transcripts or sealed evaluation concepts
calibration_C.estimation_contract: freeze immutable public model revisions and hashes, fixed bins plus quartiles, explicit missingness and abstention, bootstrap uncertainty with public seed 42, and one governed commitment before generation
calibration_C.limitations: small feature set only; measured and unavailable features reported separately; no full distributional calibration claim
calibration_C.disclosure: Git and external reporting receive only compact non-identifying bins targets uncertainty missingness and a commitment after applicant disclosure review; suppress sparse or reconstructive cells and never export raw media text exact vocabulary embeddings row-level per-child or per-session statistics IDs or reconstructive combinations
calibration_C.episode_plan: freeze a public nonrestricted episode-plan distribution matched axis-by-axis to approved targets using only public lexical resources and no sealed evaluation concepts or outcomes
calibration_C.local_generator_input: inside applicant-governed Juno storage, LTX may consume the committed compact C aggregate target table and public self-authored episode-plan distribution; neither the table nor aggregate-conditioned prompts leave the governed boundary
calibration_C.attempt_accounting: measure every generated attempt and the accepted corpus separately
calibration_C.scale_up_evidence: real arm learns; synthetic improves over initialization; synthetic-real realistic macro gap at most 0.05; held-out-real temporal safeguard non-catastrophic; no critical calibration-axis failure; most axes within frozen tolerances; no severe preregistered joint-distribution miss; acceptable unique-hour yield and cost
calibration_C.authorization_interpretation: the signed ChildLens scope permits non-commercial model calibration and evaluation; local applicant-only LTX execution keeps every restricted or aggregate-conditioned generator input on governed UTD storage and grants no third-party access

nested_order: HMAC-SHA-256(secret_budget_key, UTF8('train-budget') || UTF8(opaque_session_id)); then HMAC-SHA-256(secret_budget_key, UTF8('train-item') || UTF8(opaque_media_id))
acquisition: stop after exactly 1.0 credited real hour plus 10 percent accepted-yield reserve; retain keyed resumability; extend to nested 3.0 hours only if Real-1h fails
credited_time: union of unique accepted source-timeline ASR windows with decodable eligible frames; adapter abstentions receive zero
checkpoint_rule: initialized checkpoint before any optimizer step; matched trained arms use the checkpoint immediately after exactly 570 scheduler steps; no arm-specific tuning stopping or selection
initialized_baseline: evaluate byte-identical 0h initialization before training without adapting any rule

real_1h_gate.temporal_rule: Recall@1 and MRR must both be finite and neither may decline by more than 0.05 absolute from initialized

conditional_real_3h_gate.temporal_rule: Recall@1 and MRR must both be finite and neither may decline by more than 0.05 absolute from initialized

generator_gate.selection_basis: prospective user-directed cost selection made before matched synthetic generation or synthetic learner scores; locally run LTX avoids per-second hosted charges but accepts the quality disadvantage measured in the completed blinded screen
generator_gate.bakeoff_interpretation: Gemini led at 27/28 primary checks, MiniMax H3 scored 25/28, Seedance 24/28, and LTX 19/28; LTX is selected for local cost and reproducibility and must never be described as the bakeoff quality winner
generator_gate.execution: applicant-only local execution on governed Juno storage with pinned cached dependencies local-files-only loading disabled telemetry and no hosted API

resource_projection.qualification: linear planning estimate only; accepted credited yield retries and final Juno topology must be measured before scale-up

generator_gate.resource_gate: before corpus generation run a bounded public/dummy preflight on the intended final Juno GPU type and freeze exact GPU count aggregate GPU-hour wall-time storage and attempt ceilings
generator_gate.privacy: all C aggregates aggregate-conditioned prompts plans attempts outputs logs and QA remain in applicant-governed Juno storage; no ChildLens/BabyView artifact or derivative is sent to a provider
generator_gate.quality_limitation: LTX had the weakest completed-bakeoff primary score and more critical failures; do not tune evaluation assets or silently expand retry thresholds to compensate
generator_gate.audio: discard LTX native audio and retain the frozen modular German TTS path

synthetic_arm: only after real learnability and generator gates pass; exactly match accepted credited duration and objective steps
directionally_competitive_rule: both trained arms improve realistic macro by at least 0.02 over initialization and synthetic-real absolute macro gap is at most 0.05
